'''R0-B5U''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that served with [[Yarvok]] among the [[Nova Blades]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. R0-B5U participated in the [[Dantooine Incursion]] and was stationed at the entrance of the [[Banir Regional Energy Complex|Dantooine Power Station]] to accept ransom payments totalling fifteen million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in exchange for the station's [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
R0-B5U first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] expansion. If the player pays R0-B5U the fifteen million credits Yarvok demands, the Nova Blades will leave peacefully, however, if the player does not, Yarvok will need to defeated in battle to prompt the pirates to retreat.<ref name="SWTOR" />
